children: Modine reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 net sales of $994.4 million, up 35% year over year, while net earnings fell to $30.3 million. Adjusted diluted EPS increased 27% to $1.35, and the company raised its full-year outlook for its continuing businesses following the Performance Technologies spin-off.
Net sales increased 35% to $994.4 million from $738.9 million a year earlier.
Gross profit rose to $205.4 million from $164.9 million; gross margin was 20.7%, down 160 basis points year over year.
Operating income increased 33% to $97.8 million from $73.5 million.
Net earnings were $30.3 million, down from $44.8 million; the quarter included $29.5 million of income tax expense related to legal-entity restructuring for the spin-off.
Adjusted diluted EPS increased to $1.35 from $1.06.

Data Centers sales increased 95%, driven primarily by higher sales to hyperscale customers in North America. The segment reported record orders and backlog, and Modine entered long-term agreements with strategic suppliers to secure critical components.

Commercial HVAC sales grew 23%, with higher sales of coils, coatings, and heating and ventilation products. The company also cited expanding opportunities to serve data center cooling demand through this segment.
Performance Technologies sales were up less than 1%; gains in power generation and commercial vehicles were largely offset by declines in automotive and off-highway customers.
Modine completed the spin-off of Performance Technologies on October 1. Beginning in the third fiscal quarter, the business will be reported as discontinued operations.

For fiscal 2027, Modine expects continuing-business net sales of $3.1 billion to $3.2 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $470 million to $500 million. The revenue outlook represents expected growth of 50% to 55% excluding Performance Technologies from both periods.
